classes.name: Methylphenidate stimulants
classes.description: CNS stimulants in the methylphenidate family: methylphenidate IR/ER (Ritalin, Concerta, Metadate, Aptensio, Jornay PM, Quillichew, Cotempla), dexmethylphenidate IR/ER (Focalin), serdexmethylphenidate/dexmethylphenidate (Azstarys), methylphenidate patch (Daytrana).
classes.plainDescription: A stimulant pill or patch for ADHD from the Ritalin/Concerta family.

classes.name: Amphetamine stimulants
classes.description: CNS stimulants in the amphetamine family: mixed amphetamine salts IR/ER (Adderall, Adderall XR, Mydayis), lisdexamfetamine (Vyvanse, capsule and chewable), dextroamphetamine (Dexedrine, Zenzedi, Xelstrym patch), amphetamine sulfate (Evekeo), amphetamine ER (Adzenys, Dyanavel).
classes.plainDescription: A stimulant for ADHD from the Adderall/Vyvanse family.

classes.name: Non-stimulant ADHD agents
classes.description: Non-stimulant ADHD agents: atomoxetine (Strattera), viloxazine ER (Qelbree), guanfacine ER (Intuniv), clonidine ER (Kapvay).
classes.plainDescription: A daily ADHD medicine that is not a stimulant.
